liveInbox.title: Live inbox
liveInbox.description: Deliver requests sent to this session through kata notify as they arrive, without waiting for the next prompt. Off: the inbox is read once per prompt. KATA_CLAUDE_LIVE_INBOX=0 also turns it off.
